g.text: Dataset fixed at 113.2B quotes · D1/D2 once each; A1–A4 six times each
Combined rate: weighted bytes / weighted query execution time; scheduling idle gaps excluded. Warm data cache; result cache off.
Per-core panel divides by selected cores. Parallelism set with max_threads on a fixed 59-vCPU / 236-GiB service.
12 measured rounds; shading shows round IQR. Shared axis ranges across options. No smoothing or discarded observations.
